title: FOMC decision (meeting Mar 16-17, 2027 — first SEP of 2027)
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, re-fetched raw direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes) and parsed panel-by-panel by this session. The 2027 panel reads verbatim 'January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*', with the page's own footnote '* Meeting associated with a Summary of Economic Projections' — so the asterisk is the primary evidence this carries the FIRST SEP of 2027. The decision publishes on the second day at 14:00 ET per the standing convention, which is NOT read off this page. Filed estimate for exactly the reason the sibling fomc-2027-01-27 entry gives: the Fed's own page states every 2027 date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep
notes: DISCOVERED during the boj-decision-2027-03-18 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), and the entire reason it is tracked here: this decision concludes at 14:00 ET on 2027-03-17, which is 03:00 JST on 2027-03-18 — the morning of the Bank of Japan's own MPM decision day (boj-decision-2027-03-18, estimate). The BoJ board's second deliberation day and its midday-JST announcement both come AFTER a US decision that carries the year's first SEP. Two consequences that lane measured rather than asserted. (1) ATTRIBUTION: on the Federal Reserve's own H.10 noon-ET USD/JPY fixing (FRED DEXJPUS) a single daily bar spans noon 3/17 to noon 3/18, so it contains BOTH decisions and cannot be decomposed on that series; the 2026 analogue is exact (FOMC 2026-03-18, BoJ 2026-03-19) and its combined bar was -0.81%. (2) STRUCTURE: parsed off the same Fed page today, the March FOMC and the March BoJ decision have fallen within +/-2 calendar days in 6 of the 7 years the page covers (2021 +2, 2022 +2, 2023 -12, 2024 -1, 2025 0, 2026 +1, 2027 +1, signed as BoJ-minus-FOMC), and EVERY March FOMC on the page carries the SEP asterisk. The March BoJ meeting is chronically FOMC-contaminated; 2027 replicates 2026's ordering exactly. Also note the blackout arithmetic the fomc-2027-01-27 entry establishes (second Saturday before a Tuesday start) puts this meeting's blackout start at 2027-03-06 — not filed as its own entry here, only recorded. Estimate widens caution only; promote once the preceding 2027 meeting confirms the date.
